paths.prompt: Fix read-only SQLite access for database filenames containing spaces, Unicode, #, ?, & or literal %. Add common.readonly_sqlite(path) as the shared helper and use it in every read-only database connection in compact_search.py, search.py, enrich.py and catalog.py. Preserve existing public methods and their result semantics. Existing files must remain read-only; missing files must raise sqlite3.OperationalError without creating anything. Use Python's standard library. Add your own regression tests and run them.

inflate.prompt: Harden the production compressed-block decoder compact_search.inflate without changing valid results. Enforce a MAX_COMPRESSED constant of 1 MiB in addition to the existing 32 MiB inflated bound. Reject corrupt or truncated zlib, trailing garbage, concatenated streams, wrong SHA256, invalid JSON and either exceeded bound with ValueError. Check the compressed bound before decoding, and keep inflation bounded throughout. Unicode JSON must still round-trip. Do not relax existing validation. Add your own regression tests and run them.

atomic.prompt: Repair common.atomic_json for concurrent writers. Its fixed .tmp name makes simultaneous evidence writes interfere. Use a unique temporary file in the destination directory and atomic replacement. Each successful write must publish complete valid JSON; failures before replacement must preserve any previous destination bytes. Remove only that call's temporary file after both success and failure. Leave unrelated files alone. Preserve the public API, JSON content and common.norm/file_sha256. Standard library only. Add tests for concurrency and failure cleanup and run them.

filters.prompt: Extend the real Catalog.nearby facade with optional name and city keyword filters for Overture search, forwarding both to compact_search.search. Keep all existing positional arguments and default output contracts intact. Exact-name normalization and exact city matching already live in compact_search, so reuse them. If a nonempty diet is selected, any non-None name, city or category filter must raise ValueError rather than invent a cross-source join; this includes empty strings explicitly provided as filters. Diet-only calls must remain supported. Keep source-family attribution, enrichment candidates and unknown live status intact. Add your own regression tests and run them.

scope: Four selected project maintenance tasks, not local.ai Intelligence Index or official benchmark replication.
